acceptance.failure_condition: production entry point is bypassed by a test-only imitation
preconditions: exact source and oracle manifest resolve
acceptance.proof: production ingress/consumer adapter executes the frozen envelope and oracle corpus locally
acceptance.requirement: The real consumer entry path implements validation, raw capture, poison classification, retry and sink interfaces.
acceptance.resume_point: requalify source, recreate environment, then enter the production adapter
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: discard disposable local state; no cloud cleanup applies
acceptance.stale_evidence: all local test and coverage evidence

acceptance.failure_condition: a crash loses an event or repeats an application effect
preconditions: crash journal seed and all eight boundaries frozen
durable adapters are substitutable without semantic bypass
acceptance.proof: deterministic crash journal for every EP-CRASH boundary compared with the independent oracle
acceptance.requirement: Checkpoint and durable-effect behavior is locally proven under interruption and restart.
acceptance.resume_point: resume from the first unverified crash boundary after root-cause repair
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: preserve failure journal; restore isolated local stores from fixture seed
acceptance.stale_evidence: that boundary and all later recovery evidence

acceptance.failure_condition: TTL, replay, conflict, poison, hot-key or throttling branch lacks a deliberate test
acceptance.proof: ordinary, property/metamorphic and injected-failure tests with critical-branch coverage
acceptance.requirement: The complete local implementation is tested against the Part 1 authority.
acceptance.resume_point: repair the narrow branch and rerun the full local implementation suite
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: discard test stores and retain failing seed and transcript
acceptance.stale_evidence: coverage, mutation/property, and implementation acceptance evidence

acceptance.failure_condition: account, region, role, policy, quota, backend, budget or lease is unknown or mismatched
preconditions: quota, budget, backend and lease readable
acceptance.proof: fresh read-only admission receipt bound to exact merged main
acceptance.requirement: AWS admission must pass before planning or deployment.
acceptance.resume_point: repeat admission from identity resolution on exact current main
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: perform no apply; release any acquired lease without deleting pre-existing resources

acceptance.failure_condition: saved plan is stale, source-unbound, destructive, publicly open or over budget
preconditions: provider lock and immutable variables recorded
acceptance.proof: independent saved-plan review with source, provider-lock, account, region and variable identity
acceptance.requirement: The exact infrastructure plan is reviewed before apply.
acceptance.resume_point: create and review a new saved plan from fresh admission
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: do not apply; remove only disposable local plan copies after preserving reviewed digest
acceptance.stale_evidence: prior plan approval and every plan-derived inventory

acceptance.failure_condition: consumer wiring, encryption, identity, lease or telemetry smoke check fails
preconditions: smoke workload and abort thresholds frozen
acceptance.proof: bounded deployment inventory and small canary bound to run and source
acceptance.requirement: The minimal managed path must start and be observable before workload authorization.
acceptance.resume_point: resume at fresh admission if identity/plan changed, otherwise at corrected canary
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: stop workload; execute reviewed destroy/rollback and verify owned-resource inventory
acceptance.stale_evidence: failed canary and all downstream managed evidence
stop_conditions: wiring, encryption, identity, telemetry or canary failure

acceptance.failure_condition: source, archive, disposition or output differs from the independent fixed-seed oracle
preconditions: fixed seed, counts, rates, bytes and oracle outputs immutable
acceptance.proof: source/archive/output counts, keys and digests for predeclared workloads
acceptance.requirement: Baseline and correctness workloads reconcile exactly.
acceptance.resume_point: repair root cause, reset generation, rerun from baseline seed
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: stop producer, preserve evidence, retain stack only within lease for diagnosis
acceptance.stale_evidence: baseline and every dependent performance/recovery result

acceptance.failure_condition: any injected crash, duplicate, conflict, late, poison, skew or sink fault has unexplained loss or double application
preconditions: fault schedule and boundary IDs frozen
state snapshots and abort hooks ready
acceptance.proof: managed failure timelines, restart state and oracle comparison
acceptance.requirement: All mandatory recovery boundaries are proven in managed execution.
acceptance.resume_point: resume at failed boundary with a fresh generation after repair
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: stop injection and producer; preserve state; roll back or destroy under lease policy
acceptance.stale_evidence: failed boundary and all later fault/recovery claims

acceptance.failure_condition: replay overwrites live output, double counts, or uses incomplete/corrupt raw input
acceptance.predecessor: P4-001 reconciled raw archive and P4-002 recovery acceptance
acceptance.proof: isolated replay-generation inventory and canonical comparison
acceptance.requirement: Replay completeness and generation isolation are proven.
acceptance.resume_point: resume from raw reconciliation or a fresh replay generation
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: stop replay; preserve conflicting keys; delete only isolated failed generation after review
stop_conditions: live overwrite or duplicate canonical effect

acceptance.failure_condition: metric population, clocks, exclusions, sample count or thresholds cannot be reproduced
preconditions: metric definitions, clocks, exclusions, warmup and sample counts frozen
acceptance.predecessor: correct P4 workloads and faults completed
acceptance.proof: preserved metric exports and independent p50/p95/p99, lag, skew and recovery calculations
acceptance.requirement: Operational measurements are reproducible and bounded to the lab.
acceptance.resume_point: rerun only after the metric defect or workload cause is resolved
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: stop claim promotion; preserve raw exports; no metric is edited in place
acceptance.stale_evidence: derived percentiles, lag, skew and recovery measurements

acceptance.failure_condition: forecast, usage quantities or settled EventPulse cost is missing or conflated
preconditions: price date/region and quantity sources recorded
hard cost cap and stop alarm active
acceptance.predecessor: P3 forecast plus completed bounded resource lifetimes
acceptance.proof: dated forecast, resource lifetime, usage inventory and later settled billing
acceptance.requirement: Forecast and observed spend remain separate and within the hard cap.
acceptance.resume_point: resume from a newly approved forecast; settle billing after provider lag
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: stop/tear down owned resources at cap trigger and preserve billing snapshots
acceptance.stale_evidence: cost forecast, observed estimate and settled-cost claim
stop_conditions: usage or settled billing cannot be attributed

acceptance.failure_condition: owned resource absence is inferred from delete success, AccessDenied or incomplete inventory
preconditions: complete owned-resource inventory and reviewed destroy plan
acceptance.predecessor: all managed evidence preserved and workload stopped
acceptance.proof: pre/post inventory, reviewed destroy plan, list/describe absence and lease release
acceptance.requirement: Teardown is independently verified with no unexplained residue.
acceptance.resume_point: resume at the first resource whose absence is not proven
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: retain lease/blocker; never infer absence; escalate least-privilege cleanup access
acceptance.stale_evidence: teardown, final cost and no-residue claims

acceptance.failure_condition: a public sentence lacks source, run, oracle, metric definition or limit
preconditions: exact main, manifests, runs and evidence resolve
acceptance.predecessor: verified Part 4 completion including teardown and settled claim boundaries
acceptance.proof: skeptical claim-to-evidence audit on exact main
acceptance.requirement: Every README and resume claim is independently defensible.
acceptance.resume_point: resume at the first failed claim mapping after correction
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: revert only the unsupported draft sentence; preserve audit finding
acceptance.stale_evidence: affected public artifact and downstream release review

acceptance.failure_condition: architecture, tradeoff, failure/repair, scope, cost or limit cannot be explained from repository evidence
acceptance.proof: reproducible local demonstration and interview walkthrough review
acceptance.requirement: The project can be defended to a senior data engineer.
acceptance.resume_point: repair evidence or narrow wording, then repeat the full walkthrough
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: make no release claim; preserve question and gap as a finding
stop_conditions: tradeoff, limit or repair lacks evidence

acceptance.failure_condition: release tag, source, assets, digests, claim ledger or completion receipt disagree
preconditions: release inventory, digests and final claim ledger frozen
acceptance.predecessor: P5-001 and P5-002 accepted on exact main
acceptance.proof: exact-head/final-main CI, deterministic release inventory and final completion receipt
acceptance.requirement: Publication and finality bind all claims to one verified release.
acceptance.resume_point: rebuild release inventory from newly verified exact main
acceptance.rollback_cleanup: do not publish or move a tag; withdraw inconsistent draft assets
acceptance.stale_evidence: release candidate and final project-completion claim
stop_conditions: final CI or independent audit fails
